description: This PHP class 'PlainTextReportRenderer' handles the rendering of report templates into plain text files, saving these files as attachments related to reports. It uses Twig for templating, manages file paths, and interacts with an attachment repository.

classes.name: PlainTextReportRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering report templates as plain text files, storing them as attachments, and managing related file paths and metadata.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a report template with given variables, writes the output as a plain text file, creates an attachment object for the file, and saves it via the attachment repository.
